assumptions: Debye length uses supplied global ne and Maxwellian Te.
Skin depth and bulk wavelength use a homogeneous unmagnetized collisional Drude plasma with exp(j omega t).
Effective radial wavelength is from the distributed sheet/axial circuit, including user sheet impedance; it is not a full Maxwell eigenmode.
All density and collision coefficients are prescribed; none is fitted to force a requested distribution.

optimizer.method: bounded log least_squares with physical multistarts

metadata.success_definition: numerical particle, reduced energy, pressure, atom and charge closure only

source_corrections.basis: Both reactants contain two oxygen atoms; add product multiplicity 2 to conserve oxygen.
Three reactant densities require coefficient m^6/s; numerical value preserved.
Move the printed [O2] density factor into explicit three-body mass action; do not double-count.
Add emitted electron for charge conservation; separate printed [O] factor into third reactant.

omitted_reactions.reason: Printed reaction destroys one positive charge without an electron. Replacing O2+ with neutral O2 would conserve charge but is an unverified interpretation, so the solver excludes k49.
omitted_reactions.effect: Full 49-reaction reproduction not achieved; no success assertion permitted.

wall_return_reactions.source: Table 2 p.1103; section 2.2 p.1104; gamma measured stainless steel at 300 K
Table 2 p.1103; assumes same probability as atomic O
Table 2 p.1103; section 2.2 p.1104; quenching measured on Fe surface

O.source: NIST Atomic Spectra Database, neutral oxygen ground-state ionization energy

O2.source: NIST Chemistry WebBook SRD69, evaluated molecular oxygen ionization energy

ionization_energies_ev.role: Supplementary physical threshold values, not numerical values explicitly verified in the 2001/2000 paper. Rate-fit activation parameters are not thresholds.

closures.absorbed_power: total plasma absorbed power: collisional + electron-wall + ion-wall
closures.energy: source eq.(3) reduced ground-target collisional budget; not all 48 reaction energies
closures.ionization: ground O2 k1 and ground O k4 with supplementary NIST thresholds
closures.excitation: all 16 source-26 terms once; no additional per-particle excitation charge
closures.elastic: 3*me/mi*Te*ne*nu_i; supplied nu_i are per-electron s^-1 frequencies, not m^3/s
closures.wall_energy: electron: 2Te; ion: phi+Te/2; each applied once to ion-balanced wall flux
closures.pressure: sum of five neutral densities = p/(kB*Tg); ion pressure neglected
closures.flow: pure O2 feed; common unknown neutral pumping rate; charged pumping zero
closures.hL_hR: explicit inputs; source electronegative edge closure not solved
closures.surface: explicit gammaO (also O_1D), gammaMeta; source gammaO .17+/- .02 measured on stainless steel at 300K; gammaMeta .007 measured on Fe and adopted in the paper's SUS case; neither is a Si coefficient

unresolved_energy_channels: Excited-target ionization k17/k19 has no additional reaction-resolved energy term in the reduced source budget.
Electron detachment k7, superelastic k21, attachment k3/k20 and additional dissociation k22/k43 lack a full supplied energy-transfer table.
New electrons from heavy-particle detachment do not have a supplied birth-energy distribution.

transport.source_domain_valid_definition: reaction-fit domain only; transport_domain_valid is separate
